privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Groundup Society Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share your personal data in our mobile app and website.

paragraphs: Groundup Society's Privacy Policy describes how Groundup Society collects, uses, and shares your personal data.

In addition to this Privacy Policy, we provide data and privacy information embedded in our App and certain features that ask to use your personal data or device permissions. This product-specific information is shown when you create an account, enable optional permissions, or use features such as walking challenges, store locator, notifications, or profile photo upload.

You will be given an opportunity to review permission requests and legal terms before using these features. You also can view this information at any time in the App settings or online at groundupsociety.picominds.com/privacy.
You can familiarize yourself with our privacy practices, accessible via the headings below, and contact us if you have any questions.

sections.title: What Is Personal Data at Groundup Society?

paragraphs: At Groundup Society, we believe strongly in being transparent about how we collect and use your data. This section describes personal data in the context of our membership app and services.

Personal data is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information you provide directly, information generated through your membership activity, and information collected from your device when you grant permission for optional features.

Examples of personal data we process include your name, email address, mobile number, birthday, account identifiers, reward and order history, referral activity, optional health step data, optional location data, profile photo, and device push notification tokens.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights at Groundup Society

paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing of your personal data, to withdraw consent, and to receive a portable copy of your data.

You can update much of your account information directly in the App. For other requests, contact tam@onemotionmanagement.com. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request and will respond within the time required by applicable law.
If you are in the United Kingdom or European Economic Area, you may also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

You can opt out of marketing communications at any time through your account settings or by contacting us. You can manage optional device permissions, including health, location, camera, photos, and notifications, in your device settings.

sections.title: Personal Data Groundup Society Collects from You

paragraphs: We collect personal data you provide when you register, complete your profile, place orders, redeem rewards, participate in challenges or promotions, communicate with us, or use in-store membership features.

subsections.title: Account and profile information
paragraphs: When you create a Groundup Society account, we collect your first and last name, email address, mobile number, birthday, password (stored in hashed form), marketing opt-in preference, and referral code if you provide one. You may also choose to upload a profile photo.

subsections.title: Membership and transaction information
paragraphs: We collect information about your use of membership features, including reward points, order history, coupon collections and redemptions, challenge enrollment and progress, referral activity, member QR code usage, and records of your acceptance of our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, including version and timestamp.

subsections.title: Communications
paragraphs: We collect information related to email verification during signup, password reset requests, push notifications and in-app messages, and support enquiries you send to us.

subsections.title: Optional device and permission-based data
paragraphs: With your permission, we may collect step count data from Apple Health or Health Connect for walking challenges; approximate location while using the App to show nearby stores; camera input when staff scan member QR codes or when you upload images; photo library access when you choose images to upload; and push notification tokens to deliver alerts to your device.

sections.title: Personal Data Groundup Society Receives from Other Sources

paragraphs: We may receive limited personal data from service providers and partners that help us operate the Service.

For example, we use cloud hosting and authentication providers to operate accounts and store profile data; email delivery providers to send verification codes and account messages; and push notification infrastructure to deliver alerts to your device.
If another member uses your referral code during signup, we receive information needed to attribute the referral and apply programme rewards in accordance with our rules.

sections.title: Groundup Society's Use of Personal Data

paragraphs: We use personal data to power the Service, provide membership benefits, and keep our platform secure. This includes:
bullets: Creating and managing your member account and profile
Authenticating you and protecting your account
Processing orders, rewards, redemptions, coupons, and referrals
Operating walking challenges and step-based promotions when you enable health permissions
Showing nearby stores when you enable location permissions
Sending service messages such as verification codes, password resets, order updates, and account notices
Sending marketing communications where you have opted in
Providing customer support and responding to your requests
Detecting, preventing, and addressing fraud, abuse, and security issues
Complying with legal obligations and enforcing our Terms of Use
Understanding aggregated usage patterns to improve our App, menu, stores, and services

subsections.title: Legal bases for processing
paragraphs: Where UK GDPR, EU GDPR, or similar laws apply, we rely on contract (to provide membership services), legitimate interests (to secure and improve the Service), consent (for optional marketing and device permissions), and legal obligation (where we must retain or disclose information).

sections.title: Groundup Society's Sharing of Personal Data

paragraphs: Groundup Society does not sell your personal data.
We share personal data only in the circumstances described below.

subsections.title: Service providers
paragraphs: We work with companies that provide services on our behalf, such as cloud hosting, database and authentication services, email delivery, and push notification delivery. These providers process personal data only as needed to perform services for us and are required to protect it.

subsections.title: Groundup staff and stores
paragraphs: Authorized staff may access member information in store to verify identity, process orders, apply rewards, and provide support.

subsections.title: Legal, safety, and business transfers
paragraphs: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or governmental request, or to protect the rights, safety, and security of our members, staff, and business. If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, personal data may be transferred as part of that transaction subject to continued protections.

sections.title: Protection of Personal Data at Groundup Society

paragraphs: Groundup Society implements administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal data, including encrypted connections, access controls, and hashed password storage.

No method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure. You can help protect your account by using a strong password and keeping your login credentials confidential. Please contact us immediately if you believe your account has been compromised.
The Groundup Society App is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
If you are between 13 and the age of majority in your country, you may use the Service only with permission from a parent or legal guardian where required by law.
If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, contact tam@onemotionmanagement.com and we will take steps to delete it.
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to operate pages, remember preferences, and understand how visitors use the site.
The mobile App does not use advertising cookies. The App may store local preferences and session information on your device to keep you signed in and remember settings.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

sections.title: Transfer of Personal Data Between Countries

paragraphs: We are based in the United Kingdom. Your personal data may be processed in the UK and in other countries where our service providers operate.
Where personal data is transferred outside your country, we use appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent protections required by applicable law.

sections.title: Our Companywide Commitment to Your Privacy

paragraphs: To make sure your personal data is secure, we communicate our privacy and security guidelines to staff and enforce privacy safeguards across the business.
We design our App to minimize the data we collect, ask for permission before accessing optional device data, and review our practices as we add new features.
When we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will update the date at the top of this page and may ask you to review and accept the updated version before continuing to use the Service.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact our privacy team:
Email: tam@onemotionmanagement.com
Support: tam@onemotionmanagement.com
Website: https://groundupsociety.picominds.com
Postal address: Groundup Society, United Kingdom
